environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application running in a Docker container (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0) on ECS Fargate. Container runs as root with default Docker seccomp profile. No reverse proxy or WAF in front. Application binds directly to port 443 via Kestrel with a self-signed certificate. The /etc/oauth/ and /var/log/oauth/ directories are mounted from an EFS volume with standard permissions (755/644). DNS resolution is unrestricted.
